title: 9007199254740993 > 9007199254740992.0 is FALSE: the integer loses its last digit in the comparison

source.quote: DAX does implicit conversions for numeric or date/time types as the following table describes
source.supports: the comparison table that follows gives REAL for INTEGER compared with REAL, and INTEGER for INTEGER with INTEGER

derivation: INTEGER compared with REAL is compared as REAL. 9007199254740993 (2^53 + 1) converts to the double 9007199254740992, equal to the right side, so it is not greater.
alternative: If the engine compares the exact values, 2^53 + 1 is greater than 2^53 and the result is TRUE.
